basics.name: Lawrenze Maranan
basics.label: Full-Stack & AI Engineer
basics.summary: Eight years building software, and now the AI that runs inside it. I'm Lawrenze Maranan, a full-stack and AI engineer with eight years of building reliable, user-focused applications. Most of my backend work is in PHP frameworks; on the front end, modern JavaScript. Lately it is agents: orchestration, tools, evaluation, and keeping them honest in production.
